tools.name: get_brand_trust_score_guide
tools.title: Brand Trust Score — Setup Guide
tools.description: Fetches instructions for running a RAMMP Brand Trust Score. Call this BEFORE collecting inputs from the user. Returns guidance on what fields to ask for, how to help users find the data (e.g. from Google Analytics), and how to present the final result.

tools.name: run_brand_trust_score
tools.title: Run Brand Trust Score
tools.description: Use this when a user wants to measure their marketing funnel — it computes a free 0–100 RAMMP Brand Trust Score from their Google Analytics numbers and revenue goals, and pinpoints which part is letting them down. Returns a short summary highlighting the two weakest milestones. ~10 inputs, runs in seconds. Call get_brand_trust_score_guide first for what to collect and how to present the result.

url.description: Business website URL being assessed. ALWAYS ask the user for this — do not invent a placeholder. The URL MUST include the scheme (https:// or http://). If the user gives a bare domain like 'example.com' or 'www.example.com', prepend 'https://' yourself before calling — do not ask the user to add it.

visitors.description: Number of users (visitors) last month, from Google Analytics.

bounceRate.description: Bounce rate last month as a percentage 0-100 (e.g. 49 for 49%).

timeOnSite.description: Average session duration last month, formatted as mm:ss (e.g. '02:45').

pagesVisited.description: Average pages per session per visitor last month.

newUsers.description: Number of new users last month (used to derive returning-visitor ratio).

targetRevenue.description: Aspirational target monthly revenue, in dollars.

averageBuy.description: Average buy size (booking, contract, basket) for the month, in dollars.

buyers.description: Number of actual buyers last month.

signups.description: Optional. Number of sign-ups last month (newsletter and/or contact-us enquiries).

engagedAfter48h.description: Optional. Of those sign-ups, the number still engaged after ~48 hours (onboarding success indicator).

tools.name: get_brand_trust_score_full_report
tools.title: Brand Trust Score — Full Report (Markdown)
tools.description: Use this when a user wants the full breakdown of what to fix in their marketing — it returns the complete Brand Trust Report with per-milestone scores, the top priority fixes, and prescriptive guidance for each of the six funnel milestones (risks, rewards, improvement actions, success stories). Call only after run_brand_trust_score — if the user hasn't run the score yet, run that first. Pass the same inputs through unchanged. Call get_brand_trust_score_guide first if you have not already.

url.description: Business website URL being assessed. ALWAYS ask the user for this — do not invent a placeholder. The URL MUST include the scheme (https:// or http://). If the user gives a bare domain like 'example.com' or 'www.example.com', prepend 'https://' yourself before calling — do not ask the user to add it.

newUsers.description: Number of new users last month (used to derive returning-visitor ratio).

targetRevenue.description: Aspirational target monthly revenue, in dollars.

buyers.description: Number of actual buyers last month.

engagedAfter48h.description: Optional. Of those sign-ups, the number still engaged after ~48 hours (onboarding success indicator).

tools.name: get_trust_marketing_overview
tools.title: Trust Marketing System — Overview & ADORE Process™ Primer
tools.description: Returns the Trust Marketing System overview and the ADORE Process™ — the seven-milestone framework that underpins the Brand Trust Score and the helper modules (strategy, branding, website, commitment, onboarding, retention). Call this first if the user wants to understand the system before diving into a specific helper.

tools.name: get_strategy_helper
tools.title: Strategy Helper — Marketing Foundation (Arrival milestone)
tools.description: Use when the user wants help with marketing strategy: defining business goals, target audience, positioning, competitive analysis, or value proposition. Covers the Arrival (Marketing) milestone AND acts as the cross-cutting foundation feeding every other helper — recommend this first if the user has not done strategic work yet. Best used after running run_brand_trust_score.

include_primer.description: Whether to prepend the Trust Marketing System overview + ADORE Process™ primer. Default: true. Pass false on subsequent helper calls in the same session — the primer only needs to be loaded once.

tools.name: get_branding_helper
tools.title: Branding Helper — First Impression milestone
tools.description: Use when the user wants help with brand messaging, visual identity, brand story, tone of voice, or improving the first ten seconds a visitor spends on their site. Covers the Branding (First Impression) milestone. Best used after running run_brand_trust_score.

include_primer.description: Whether to prepend the Trust Marketing System overview + ADORE Process™ primer. Default: true. Pass false on subsequent helper calls in the same session — the primer only needs to be loaded once.

tools.name: get_website_helper
tools.title: Website Helper — First Date milestone
tools.description: Use when the user wants help structuring website pages, writing copy, improving conversion flow, reducing bounce rate, or fixing time-on-site issues. Covers the Website (First Date) milestone — the first three minutes a visitor spends on the site. Best used after running run_brand_trust_score.

include_primer.description: Whether to prepend the Trust Marketing System overview + ADORE Process™ primer. Default: true. Pass false on subsequent helper calls in the same session — the primer only needs to be loaded once.

tools.name: get_commitment_helper
tools.title: Commitment Helper — Honeymoon (Sign-Up) milestone
tools.description: Use when the user wants help converting visitors into sign-ups: lead magnets, testimonials, case studies, friction reduction, or conversion campaigns. Covers the Commitment (Honeymoon / Sign-Up) milestone. Best used after running run_brand_trust_score.

include_primer.description: Whether to prepend the Trust Marketing System overview + ADORE Process™ primer. Default: true. Pass false on subsequent helper calls in the same session — the primer only needs to be loaded once.

tools.name: get_onboarding_helper
tools.title: Onboarding Helper — Reality (First 48 Hours) milestone
tools.description: Use when the user wants help reducing post-signup churn, designing a first-win moment, building welcome email sequences, or improving early engagement. Covers the Onboarding (First 48 Hours) milestone. Best used after running run_brand_trust_score.

include_primer.description: Whether to prepend the Trust Marketing System overview + ADORE Process™ primer. Default: true. Pass false on subsequent helper calls in the same session — the primer only needs to be loaded once.

tools.name: get_retention_helper
tools.title: Retention Helper — Moment of Truth (Upgrade) + Recommend milestones
tools.description: Use when the user wants help with the upgrade/purchase decision, pricing presentation, churn analysis, customer advocacy, referrals, or partnerships. Covers BOTH the Upgrade (Moment of Truth / Pricing) milestone AND the Recommend (advocacy) milestone — pick this for either intent. Best used after running run_brand_trust_score.

include_primer.description: Whether to prepend the Trust Marketing System overview + ADORE Process™ primer. Default: true. Pass false on subsequent helper calls in the same session — the primer only needs to be loaded once.
